

// package main




fn owned<'call>( prefix: &'call str, payload: String) -> (impl std::future::Future<Output = (String, &'call str)> + 'call) {
    
        


async move {


return (payload, prefix);



}




    
}
fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        
let prefix = String::from("borrowed")
;


let payload = String::from("owned")
;


let pending = owned(prefix.as_str(), payload)
;


let mut pinned = Box::pin(pending)
;


let waker = std::task::Waker::noop()
;


let mut context = std::task::Context::from_waker(waker)
;


let handle = std::pin::Pin::as_mut(&mut pinned)
;


let observed = std::future::Future::poll(handle, &mut context)
;



assert_eq!(observed, std::task::Poll::Ready((String::from("owned"), "borrowed")));



let _released = drop(pinned)
;



assert_eq!(prefix, "borrowed");



    
}
